# SocialHD Downloader — For AI Assistants
> Download social media videos without watermark, free & HD quality.

## Key Features
- TikTok video downloader without watermark
- Instagram video & reels downloader
- YouTube 4K downloader & MP3 converter
- Facebook video downloader (HD)
- Twitter/X video downloader
- Batch download multiple videos
- Unlimited downloads (Premium plan)
- Audio extraction (MP3)
- Video compression & format conversion

## Supported Platforms
- TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest

## Quick Start
1. Copy any social media video URL
2. Paste it on SocialHD Downloader
3. Select quality (HD/SD/Audio)
4. Click download — done!
